pairs: Facta est autem in illa die persecutio magna in ecclesia quæ erat Jerosolymis,
Now in those days, there occurred a great persecution against the Church at Jerusalem.
et omnes dispersi sunt per regiones Judææ et Samariæ præter Apostolos.
And they were all dispersed throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the Apostles.
But God-fearing men arranged for Stephen’s funeral,
et fecerunt planctum magnum super eum.
and they made a great mourning over him.
Saulus autem devastabat ecclesiam per domos intrans,
Then Saul was laying waste to the Church by entering throughout the houses,
and dragging away men and women,
Therefore, those who had been dispersed were traveling around,
Philippus autem descendens in civitatem Samariæ,
Now Philip, descending to a city of Samaria,
Intendebant autem turbæ his quæ a Philippo dicebantur,
And the crowd was listening intently
and with one accord to those things which were being said by Philip,
and they were watching the signs which he was accomplishing.
Multi enim eorum qui habebant spiritus immundos,
For many of them had unclean spirits,
crying out with a loud voice,
Factum est ergo gaudium magnum in illa civitate.
And many of the paralytics and the lame were cured.
Therefore, there was great gladness in that city.
qui ante fuerat in civitate magus,
Now there was a certain man named Simon,
who formerly had been a magician in that city,
seducing the people of Samaria, claiming himself to be someone great.
cui auscultabant omnes a minimo usque ad maximum,
And to all those who would listen, from the least even to the greatest,
And they were attentive to him because,
propter quod multo tempore magiis suis dementasset eos.
for a long time, he had deluded them with his magic.
Cum vero credidissent Philippo evangelizanti de regno Dei,
Yet truly, once they had believed Philip, who was evangelizing the kingdom of God,
in nomine Jesu Christi baptizabantur viri ac mulieres.
both men and women were baptized in the name of Jesus Christ.
Then Simon himself also believed and,
he adhered to Philip. And now,
Videns etiam signa et virtutes maximas fieri,
seeing also the greatest signs and miracles being wrought,
Cum autem audissent Apostoli qui erant Jerosolymis,
Now when the Apostles who were in Jerusalem had heard that Samaria had received the Word of God,
miserunt ad eos Petrum et Joannem.
oraverunt pro ipsis ut acciperent Spiritum Sanctum:
they prayed for them, so that they might receive the Holy Spirit.
nondum enim in quemquam illorum venerat,
For he had not yet come to any among them,
sed baptizati tantum erant in nomine Domini Jesu.
since they were only baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Then they laid their hands on them,
and they received the Holy Spirit.
Cum vidisset autem Simon quia per impositionem manus Apostolorum daretur Spiritus Sanctus,
But when Simon had seen that, by the imposition of the hands of the Apostles, the Holy Spirit was given,
so that on whomever I will lay my hands,
he may receive the Holy Spirit.”
Pecunia tua tecum sit in perditionem:
“Let your money be with you in perdition,
quoniam donum Dei existimasti pecunia possideri.
for you have supposed that a gift of God might be possessed by money.
Non est tibi pars neque sors in sermone isto:
There is no part or place for you in this matter.
cor enim tuum non est rectum coram Deo.
For your heart is not upright in the sight of God.
Pœnitentiam itaque age ab hac nequitia tua:
And so, repent from this, your wickedness,
si forte remittatur tibi hæc cogitatio cordis tui.
so that perhaps this plan of your heart might be forgiven you.
In felle enim amaritudinis, et obligatione iniquitatis, video te esse.
For I perceive you to be in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity.”
Precamini vos pro me ad Dominum, ut nihil veniat super me horum quæ dixistis.
“Pray for me to the Lord, so that nothing of what you have said may happen to me.”
after testifying and speaking the Word of the Lord,
and they evangelized the many regions of the Samaritans.
Angelus autem Domini locutus est ad Philippum,
Now an Angel of the Lord spoke to Philip,
ad viam quæ descendit ab Jerusalem in Gazam:
to the way which descends from Jerusalem into Gaza,
powerful under Candace, the queen of the Ethiopians,
qui erat super omnes gazas ejus,
who was over all her treasures,
had arrived in Jerusalem to worship.
et revertebatur sedens super currum suum,
he was sitting upon his chariot and reading from the prophet Isaiah.
Then the Spirit said to Philip,
et adjunge te ad currum istum.
and join yourself to this chariot.”
heard him reading from the prophet Isaiah,
“Do you think that you understand what you are reading?”
unless someone will have revealed it to me?”
And he asked Philip to climb up
Locus autem Scripturæ quem legebat, erat hic:
Now the place in Scripture that he was reading was this:
Tamquam ovis ad occisionem ductus est:
“Like a sheep he was led to the slaughter.
et sicut agnus coram tondente se, sine voce,
And like a lamb silent before his shearer,
so he opened not his mouth.
In humilitate judicium ejus sublatum est.
He endured his judgment with humility.
Generationem ejus quis enarrabit? quoniam tolletur de terra vita ejus.
Who of his generation shall describe how his life was taken away from the earth?”
Then the eunuch responded to Philip,
about whom is the prophet saying this?
opening his mouth and beginning from this Scripture,
And while they were going along the way,
they arrived at a certain water source.
What would prevent me from being baptized?”
“If you believe from your whole heart,
Credo Filium Dei esse Jesum Christum.
“I believe the Son of God to be Jesus the Christ.”
And he ordered the chariot to stand still.
and the eunuch descended into the water.
And when they had ascended from the water,
the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away,
et amplius non vidit eum eunuchus.
and the eunuch did not see him anymore.
Ibat autem per viam suam gaudens.
Then he went on his way, rejoicing.
Philippus autem inventus est in Azoto,
Now Philip was found in Azotus.
And continuing on, he evangelized all the cities,
